fflate 0.8.2
===========

Vendored, unmodified UMD build of fflate (https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate),
downloaded from https://unpkg.com/fflate@0.8.2/umd/index.js

License: MIT
Copyright (c) 2023 Arjun Barrett

Used by offscreen.js to assemble the ZIP archive. It is loaded as a classic
script in offscreen.html and exposes the global `fflate`.
